name: Automated Safe Job Search & AI Scoring System

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({
  contents: [
    {
      parts: [
        {
          text: "You are an objective hiring manager and technical talent evaluator.

Evaluate the candidate against the job description below.

CANDIDATE RESUME PROFILE:
- Name: " + ($json.candidateProfile?.candidate_name || 'Nagendra M.P') + "
- Background: B.E. Computer Science (2026 Grad, CGPA 8.17), System Administrator Intern at DataCorp Traffic Limited
- Target Roles: DevOps Engineer, SRE, Cloud Engineer, Backend Developer (Python/Node.js), MLOps Engineer, AI Infrastructure Engineer
- Core Skills: Linux, Bash, Python, Docker, CI/CD, AWS, Grafana, Node.js, Express.js, FastAPI, MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, REST APIs, TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, Infrastructure Monitoring, Automation
- Projects: API & Infrastructure Monitoring System (Python, FastAPI, Grafana)
- Location Preference: Bengaluru, India (Hybrid/Onsite) OR Remote

JOB LISTING TO EVALUATE:
- Title: " + $json.title + "
- Company: " + $json.company + "
- Location: " + $json.location + "
- Remote: " + $json.remote + "
- Job Description: " + ($json.description || '') + "

EVALUATION INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Calculate a realistic match_score (integer between 1 and 100). Take seniority into account: if it strictly requires 5+ years or Staff/Lead level, penalize the score, but if it is Junior/Mid/Entry-level or skills overlap strongly (Linux, Docker, Python, AWS, CI/CD), score generously.
2. Identify matched_skills (array of skills the candidate definitely possesses).
3. Identify missing_skills (array of required skills the candidate does not list).
4. Write why_it_fits (2-3 concise sentences detailing why this role fits the candidate's career progression).
5. Write red_flags (any concerns such as heavy seniority gap, tech stack mismatch, or strict onsite outside Bengaluru).
6. Write suggested_cover_letter_opening (3-4 punchy, professional sentences tailored to this specific job that Nagendra can paste into an application).

Return ONLY a valid JSON object matching this schema:
{
  "match_score": 82,
  "matched_skills": ["Linux", "Docker", "Python", "CI/CD"],
  "missing_skills": ["Kubernetes", "Terraform"],
  "why_it_fits": "Explanation...",
  "red_flags": "None / Explanation...",
  "suggested_cover_letter_opening": "Opening paragraph..."
}"
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  generationConfig: {
    temperature: 0.2,
    responseMimeType: "application/json"
  }
}) }}

parameters.jsCode:
// Collect evaluated job for the digest
return [$input.first()];

parameters.subject: ={{ '🎯 Daily Job Digest: ' + $json.jobsCount + ' High-Match Roles Found (' + new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0] + ')' }}
⚠️ Alert: n8n Job Search Workflow Failed
